148:t_033:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「You're telling me to abandon Tokyo...!?」

148:t_033:5.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But if we keep fighting like this, we'll be driven into a situation where even retreat is impossible!」

148:t_033:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you can't make up your mind, I'll give you a push.」

148:t_034:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$バルビエル$$. $$サルディアス・アクス$$ has returned.」

148:t_034:3.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「We can't win against this...!」

148:t_034:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit whining! If we retreat here, $$新日本$$ is finished!」

148:t_034:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now then, you worthless $$新日本$$ trash! Watch the moment the invincible $$ゼロ$$ admits defeat!」

148:t_034:13.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Take the fight out to the world, all of you! We who remain will protect $$新日本$$!」

148:t_035:1.en:
$$藤堂$$
「The soul of $$新日本$$ will not die! Not as long as you, our hope, continue to exist!」

148:t_035:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「How admirable. But in the face of overwhelming power, you won't be able to spout such pretty words anymore!」

148:t_035:4.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Invader! Don't you dare look down on the pride of the Japanese!」

148:t_035:5.en:
$$藤堂$$
「This country will rise again, no matter how many times! Even if our cities are burned, our souls will not die!」

148:t_035:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then as you wish, I'll turn this city to ashes! You and $c too, all together!」

148:t_035:7.en:
$$藤堂$$
「Rather than be finished off by the likes of you, we'll do it with our own hands!」

148:t_035:9.en:
$$藤堂$$
「$$玉城$$! Use our trump card!!」

148:t_035:11.en:
$$玉城$$
「I believe you'll win in the end, no matter what, so yeaaaaah!!」

148:t_035:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, get away from the elevated highway!!」

148:t_036:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「They brought down our foothold!?」

148:t_036:2.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We won't hand over a single thing to you! Not Tokyo, and not our pride!!」

148:t_036:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, fall back! Hurry!!」

148:t_037:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「We will come back, without fail! To take $$新日本$$ back from their hands!」

148:t_037:2.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...! $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...!」

148:t_037:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Remember this! I will repay today's debt without fail!」

148:t_038:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what a thing to happen...! And just when I finally had a chance to wipe out my shame...!」

148:t_038:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fall back...! We have no choice but to bear the unbearable, endure the intolerable, and wait for another chance!」

148:t_039:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「A small fry who talks that much is pathetic.」

148:t_039:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Guys like that can come as many times as they want, and we'll just beat them back...!」

148:t_040:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what a disgrace...! To make such an ugly spectacle of myself in front of that person!」

148:t_040:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fall back...! We have no choice but to bear the unbearable, endure the intolerable, and wait for another chance!」

148:t_041:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Nobody is listening to your words.」

148:t_041:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Sorry, but we don't have time for small fry over here.」

148:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Just you watch, $$サルディアス$$...! I'll wipe out this disgrace here, and someday I'll take your position from you...!)

148:t_100:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
($c...! For that, you lot will have to serve as my stepping stones!)

148:t_101:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh...! So you're the famous Captain $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

148:t_101:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course...! You bear a more important role than you imagine yourself.」

148:t_101:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Neither I nor the Earth has time to humor that kind of nonsense...!」

148:t_101:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm just one soldier, and I'll fight to liberate the Earth!」

148:t_102:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hoho... Quite some skill. A technician of this caliber is rare even by galactic standards.」

148:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy... is he toying with us...!?」

148:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I can't afford to play around with a first-rate opponent like you, not in the slightest.」

148:t_102:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If I seem to have some room to spare, that would be the wisdom of age.」

148:t_102:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Getting swept up in his pace is dangerous...! This man... is no mere joker!」

148:t_102:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... Thank you for giving me so much credit.」

148:t_103:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now a rather unusual machine has shown up...! This planet is like a jack-in-the-box!」

148:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you talking about the $$ユニコーン$$...!」

148:t_103:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As I thought, you seem unaware. You people should learn a little more about how unique you are.」

148:t_103:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And while you're at it, please admit right away that resisting is futile.」

148:t_103:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't fall for words like that! As long as even a little possibility remains, I'll fight with everything I have!」

148:t_104:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hoho... so you're the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$ I've heard about.」

148:t_104:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, it's just... believe it or not, I've had quite a connection with Reactors...」

148:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As wide as the galaxy is, I may be the only person who has actually met this many Reactors.」

148:t_104:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, how scary. Youth that knows no fear is a frightening thing.」

148:t_104:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you don't seem to have mastered the $$スフィア$$ at all yet. That's a relief.」

148:t_104:7.en:
$n
「What do you know about my $$スフィア$$!? I'll shut that fast-talking mouth of yours!」

148:t_105:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... Even the famous $$ゼロ$$ isn't quite sharp today. The rattling seems to have worked considerably.」

148:t_105:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You are certainly a capable commander. But I can't bring myself to respect you.」

148:t_105:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for the generous praise. If I managed to draw such words out of the famous $$ゼロ$$, it will lend some prestige to my record.」
